d: Job Summary & Purpose: Responsible for day-to-day inventory activities at the store, ensuring accurate stock records, proper stock handling, timely GRN processing, stockroom management, stock reconciliation, and compliance with Sharaf DG inventory procedures.
q: 2–8 years of experience in Inventory, Warehouse, or Retail Stock Management.
Graduate preferred, Post graduate or Masters

Overall Responsibility: Ensure accurate, organized, and efficient inventory operations at the store, maintaining stock accuracy, availability, proper documentation, and compliance with Sharaf DG inventory procedures.
r: Receive, count, verify, and properly store incoming stock.
Prepare and process GRNs against LPOs, invoices, and received quantities.
Verify received quantities and report any discrepancies.
Maintain accurate inventory records in the ERP/POS system.
Conduct regular stock counting, verification, and reconciliation.
Support Perpetual Inventory (PI) counts, SNP reports, and annual stocktaking.
Prepare PRET and LTI documents as required.
Identify and properly manage Brand Promise products and ensure timely handover.
Prepare and update Purchase Return (PR) reports as required.
Manage and maintain the stockroom in an organized, safe, and secure manner.
Monitor damaged, excess, shortage, ageing, and non-moving stock and report discrepancies.
Coordinate stock transfers between stores and ensure proper documentation and system updates.
Manage HVS activities and maintain accurate inventory logbooks.
Ensure display items are properly authorized and updated in the system.
Support investigation and resolution of stock discrepancies and inventory variances.
Ensure timely closure of all inventory transactions in the ERP/POS system.
Follow inventory SOPs, checklists, audit requirements, and internal controls.
Coordinate with Store Management, Merchandising, Finance, Warehouse, Sales, and Operations teams on inventory matters.
Compliance with inventory SOPs and processes

d: We are looking for a creative, organised and trend-savvy Marketing Executive to join the Marketing Team. You'll run campaigns from start to finish, keep our social channels buzzing and bring the brand to life everywhere, from our restaurants, food trucks and pop-ups. If you love food, culture and making things go viral, we want to hear from you.

Campaign Management:Plan and run marketing campaigns for Rowleys and The Little Fox from start to finish, including seasonal promotions, limited-time menu drops and new location launches, both online and on the street.
Social Media & Digital:Manage our Instagram content calendars, write captions and briefs, and work with designers and content creators to keep the feed fresh, bold and on-trend.
Influencer & PR:Find, contact, and manage local food, lifestyle and fashion influencers. Organise tasting sessions, PR drops and collaborations that get people talking and visiting.
Events & Activations:Plan and run pop-up activations, community events and guerrilla marketing stunts that bring the brand to life in high-traffic spots around Dubai.
Performance & Reporting:Track campaign results, social growth and sales impact, and put together monthly reports with clear insights and ideas for what to try next.
q: Experience:1–3 years of hands-on marketing experience, ideally in F&B, fashion, retail or lifestyle brands, with campaigns you can proudly show off.
Social Savvy:Strong knowledge of Instagram and Meta Ads, and you keep up with trends, algorithm changes and what's catching on.
Organised Creative:Good at juggling several projects, suppliers and deadlines at once, with a creative eye for big ideas and the details that make them work.
Local Flavour:Good understanding of the UAE market, youth culture and dining scene. An existing network of influencers or local partners is a big plus.
